One environment per process directory; one transaction per environment. stash() shares one environment handles normalised path, registry entry — handle — owns current transaction, every handle inside stash_transact() joins (design.md §3.1, §10, D21). user code runs inside transaction except body stash_transact(): codecs encode write decode read. Classed conditions. Every libmdbx failure c("mdbx_<name>", "mdbx_error", ...) code name fields: mdbx_busy, mdbx_map_full, mdbx_incompatible, mdbx_bad_valsize. binding’s refusals — second open, second transaction, write read transaction, missing named database, use fork() — unclassed, dastash designed never reach . R/engine.R place catches either (design.md §13). mdbx_txn_begin(env, write = TRUE, flags = "TRY") fails mdbx_busy instead blocking; mdbx_with_write() takes flags, write loop dastash’s . Named databases created write transaction; create = TRUE read transaction refused whether database exists, missing one refused name either kind transaction. mdbx_put(overwrite = FALSE) returns FALSE existing key; mdbx_get() takes default; mdbx_del() returns whether record existed; mdbx_env_stat(txn, db =)$entries exact. environment survive fork(); open inside worker. Always open ACCEDE; effective sync flags come mdbx_env_get_flags(). 0.1.1: cursors, upper bound scan, batch get/put/del, DUPSORT, estimate_range().
